properties.name: Prozo
properties.description:
Prozo is an end-to-end supply chain ecosystem for omnichannel brands. It brings warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and technology together on one platform so brands can manage inventory and orders across B2B, D2C, marketplaces, retail and quick commerce.

The Prozo Fulfilment Network (PFN) operates 50+ tech-enabled fulfilment centres across India, spanning 3M+ sq. ft., available in Shared, Dedicated and Managed warehousing models.

The Prozo Logistics Network (PLN) covers D2C shipping, same-day and next-day delivery, hyperlocal movement, PTL and FTL freight, and appointment-based marketplace and quick-commerce deliveries — through 30+ integrated courier and logistics partners, including 15 PTL carriers. Coverage: 26,000+ pincodes for D2C surface, 24,000+ for D2C air, 8,800+ for same-day and next-day, 29,000+ for PTL and 23,600+ for heavy and bulky shipments.

Our technology connects the network:
ProOMS — order orchestration across marketplaces, D2C, quick commerce and retail, with 50+ marketplace integrations
ProWMS — warehouse operations from inbound to dispatch, with inventory visibility across fulfilment formats
ProShip by Prozo — multi-carrier allocation, tracking and NDR workflows
Command Center and Control Tower — visibility, SLA monitoring, exception management and governance

Prozo offers both pay-per-use and fixed-cost commercial models, depending on operating model, service scope and volume profile.

120+ brands work with Prozo as their supply chain partner, including Marico, Philips, VIP, Bata, Relaxo, Reliance, Swiggy, Zomato, PhonePe, Meesho, Apollo Pharmacy, HealthKart, Urban Ladder, Minimalist, The Souled Store, Pepe Jeans and Blue Tokai.
